_from: docs/clans-mines-art/config.json. One painting for each ending of each Clan Quest quest (shared/clans/quests.ts): <quest>-end-<choice>, and -lose for a puzzle answered wrong.

styles.a: Dark gritty painterly medieval fantasy game art, hand-painted oil texture, rich muted earthy colours with warm glow, dramatic cinematic light, friendly and funny, suitable for children aged 8 to 12, no heroes or adventurers in the picture, no writing, no letters, no numbers anywhere.

pictures.name: the-wandering-goat-end-0
pictures.prompt: A happy old farmer on a farmhouse doorstep hugging a goat with a brass bell, holding a large round cheese and a small bag of coins, chickens around, warm sunset farmyard. Wide landscape, the main subject in the upper and middle part, the bottom third calmer and darker.
